name: Speedcubing Aarhus Generalforsamling 2026

venue.name: Fjordsgade forenings- og fritidshus
venue.details: Solsalen, se lokationfanen / see location tab

information:
Efter konkurrencen afholdes den årlige generalforsamling for Speedcubing Aarhus. Det er valgfrit at deltage i genralforsamlingen.
_____
After the competition the yearly general assembly for Speedcubing Aarhus will be held. It is optional to participate in the general assembly.
